verdict.rationale: Jitsu ships an official MCP server so AI agents can create destinations, wire streams, inspect Live Events, and edit Functions using natural-language-driven agent tooling, with OAuth-based auth for interactive use and API-key auth for headless/CI use. This directly enables an ai-native user to operate the product via an agent instead of the UI. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on corroboration of the MCP server's reliability, no example of actual natural-language command transcripts, and no evidence of broad third-party adoption or testing.
